dataset.split_rule: hold out the last 20% (at least one) complete source motions per family; no window leakage

object.physics_note: Box inertia recomputed from size/mass; baseline G1 plus collision palms. Not an exact OmniContact simulator reproduction.

reference_contact_geometry.method: Strided samples (~50 frames per clip) from expected airborne phases; geometric hand capsule proxy, not force.

training.wall_time_scope: Training loop including compilation, excluding simulator startup and initial replay warm-up; concurrent intermediate evaluations can affect throughput.

tracking.task_success_criteria: complete clip without termination AND object endpoint error <= 0.15 m AND object tracking RMSE <= 0.20 m

carry.note: Geometric hand proximity is not measured contact force; carry evidence alone is not full task success.

reset_diagnostic.method: 160 environments, middle frame of each training clip repeated 8 times per condition; reference joint PD targets for 0.4 s, not a learned policy. Only robot reset noise differs.
reset_diagnostic.interpretation: Reset noise worsened this diagnostic but this does not isolate a cause of training failures; no reset settings were changed.

limitations: Bounded 4000-iteration feasibility trial on ten training motions and three validation motions, one seed; no independent test set.
Validation motions were inspected at multiple checkpoints; this is a validation comparison, not a blind generalization benchmark.
The simulator uses approximate palm capsules rather than the original OmniContact hand collision boxes. Source clip 6 has lower compatibility with the geometric hand proxy.
Partial lift-and-transport evidence is not full pickup/transport/placement success; geometric hand proximity is not contact force.

The carry flag also requires continuous tracking within 0.15 m and proximity of both hand capsules; a false flag does not mean the box was never carried. Clip 5 at iteration 4000 passes the full tracking task metric and visibly transports the box but fails this stricter segment proxy.
Inherited robot-only reset perturbations and 100-iteration Newton/MuJoCo-Warp solver settings were retained; solver-limit warnings occurred and were not suppressed.
Raw source/converted data, trained weights and videos remain local; only code, commands and this report are published.
